title: Portia Pence Is Missing
tagline: A Choose-Your-Own-Adventure game with a retro flavor and musical clues!
description: This project is an online, html-coded "Choose Your Own Adventure Game" inspired by the books and online games of the 80s. It's the story of Portia Pence, who has mysteriously gone missing. You have to listen to the embedded music track for clues, and decide which direction you want to go in order to find her. I created the game in html using Neocities.org, screen shots of the text storylines from terminal emulator cool-retro-term, and I created music tracks in Logic Pro with vocals to embed in the game. I also put in a couple of easter egg links to fun retro sites/video. https://portiapenceismissing.neocities.org/
how_its_made: I used Logic Pro to write/produce/record the music tracks, I used Neocities.org to create the html website "Portia Pence is Missing." I researched and used generate.photo to create an AI version of Portia Pence. I also used GifCities.org for old school gifs. I used cool-retro term Terminal Emulator to create the text story lines, then took screenshots and uploaded to my website. The NFT prize you receive at the end of the game was generated via Zora :)
